Color Notes: Use muted colors with subtle accents. Component backgrounds: transparent or var(--color-background). Minimal borders.
Motion Notes: Motion 1-4: subtle micro-interactions only. Fast transitions (150-200ms). Use FadeContent for scroll reveals.

Color Notes: Use pastel variants of --color-primary. Multiple soft shadows. Rounded corners everywhere (12-16px).
Motion Notes: Motion 2-5: soft press animations (150ms). Smooth state transitions.

Avoid Components: Brutalist components;Hard shadow components;Heavy dark components
Color Notes: Use translucent overlays: rgba(var(--color-primary-rgb), 0.15). Backdrop blur 10-20px. Light border: rgba(255,255,255,0.2).
Motion Notes: Motion 4-7: smooth backdrop-filter transitions work well. FadeContent for scroll reveals.

Color Notes: Use raw --color-primary and --color-foreground at full opacity. No gradients. Hard borders (3px+). Monospace fonts.
Motion Notes: Motion 1-3: instant or very fast transitions (0-100ms). Avoid smooth eases. Hard cuts.

Color Notes: Rich textures and 3D lighting. Use realistic shadows. Physical material properties (metallic, roughness).
Motion Notes: Motion 5-8: physics-based animation. Smooth 3D camera transitions. Realistic easing.

Color Notes: High-saturation colors. Bold color blocking. Strong contrast. Use full --color-primary intensity.
Motion Notes: Motion 4-7: energetic, bouncy animations. Spring physics. Bright color transitions.

Color Notes: Deep black (#000000 or #121212) backgrounds. Vibrant neon accents via --color-accent. Minimal glow effects. High-contrast text.
Motion Notes: Motion 3-6: smooth dark-light transitions. Glow pulse animations. Neon flicker effects.

Color Notes: WCAG AA/AAA compliant contrast (4.5:1 min). Focus indicators (3px+). Semantic color tokens.
Motion Notes: Motion 1-2: respect prefers-reduced-motion. No auto-play. Simple, short transitions.

Color Notes: Use pastel variants. Thick borders (3-4px) with --color-primary. Double shadows (inner+outer). Rounded-xl or full.
Motion Notes: Motion 4-7: bouncy animations with spring physics. Playful micro-interactions. Elastic effects.

Color Notes: Use pastel and iridescent color palettes. Soft light gradients. Translucent overlays.
Motion Notes: Motion 3-5: slow, flowing animations. Gradual color shifts. Gentle transitions.

Avoid Components: Minimalist soft components;Modern glass;Flat design components
Color Notes: Neon blue/pink/cyan on deep black. CRT scanline overlays. Monospace fonts. 80s color palette.
Motion Notes: Motion 5-8: glitch effects. CRT scanline animations. Neon pulse and flicker.

Color Notes: Solid colors (no gradients). Sharp or subtle rounded (4px). No shadows or single flat shadow. Bold typography.
Motion Notes: Motion 1-3: simple state changes. No depth-based animation. Quick transitions.

Color Notes: Rich textures and gradients. Realistic shadows with depth. Material textures (wood grain, leather stitch, metal).
Motion Notes: Motion 2-4: realistic physics. Subtle depth transitions. Press-animate with depth change.

Color Notes: Use translucent colors with fluid distortion. Gradient meshes. Dynamic blur amounts.
Motion Notes: Motion 5-8: fluid morphing animations. Organic blob transitions. Smooth distortions.

Color Notes: Colors can be bold - motion is the primary communication layer. Use accent colors for animated elements.
Motion Notes: Motion 8-10: complex choreography. Scroll-linked animations. Physics-based motion. Stagger sequences.

Color Notes: Subtle color shifts on interaction. Focus/hover states use --color-accent.
Motion Notes: Motion 1-3: 150-300ms micro-interactions. Subtle scale (0.95-1.05). Smooth hover transitions.

Color Notes: WCAG AAA contrast (7:1). Large text (16px+). Clear focus indicators. Semantic color use.
Motion Notes: Motion 1-2: respect prefers-reduced-motion. No autoplay. Subtle optional animations.

Color Notes: Minimal color use - mostly monochrome. UI fades in on demand. Transparent backgrounds.
Motion Notes: Motion 1-2: almost no visible animation. Only essential feedback. Ultra-subtle.

Color Notes: Warm neutral palette. Soft pastels. Gradient blend backgrounds. Rounded (8-12px). Gentle shadows.
Motion Notes: Motion 2-4: gentle transitions. Soft spring easing. Friendly micro-interactions.

Color Notes: Bold hero colors. High contrast headline area. CTA uses --color-accent at full opacity.
Motion Notes: Motion 4-6: impressive hero animation. Scroll-triggered reveals. Attention-grabbing but not overwhelming.

Color Notes: Neutral backgrounds with brand accent. Cards: var(--color-background) with subtle shadows. Rounded-xl (16-24px).
Motion Notes: Motion 3-5: subtle card hover scale (1.02). Stagger entrance animations. Grid reflow transitions.

Color Notes: Vibrant neon accents. Metallic gradients (silver/chrome). Glossy overlays. Hot pink + cyan + silver.
Motion Notes: Motion 5-8: energetic flashy animations. Sparkle effects. Bouncy transitions.

Color Notes: Neon glow on black. --color-accent as neon (#00FF00, #FF00FF, #00FFFF). Dark backgrounds only. Glow text-shadow.
Motion Notes: Motion 6-9: intense glitch animations. Scanline effects. Neon flicker. Fast-twitch micro-interactions.

Color Notes: Earth tones (greens #4CAF50, browns #8D6E63, creams). Organic curves. Natural soft shadows.
